subject: Every dumped coordinate over every fixture example: the line must exist in the input and the column must name a byte on it. Byte columns, counted from 1, on lines split the way S_parser_feed splits them.
purpose:
One hundred and six rows in six families, and the families are what matter — the number on its own says nothing about which of them a step is allowed to move. It was 131 before 0a.6, which cleared thirteen and added three, 122 before 0a.12, which cleared twelve and added none, and 109 before D35, which cleared three. AND THE FAMILY COUNTS BELOW WERE ALREADY WRONG BY THREE before D35 touched them: they read 61 + 19 + 9 + 9 + 6 + 2 = 106 while the ledger held 109, so continuation-line-content-offset had been undercounted since whenever it grew. Counted from the data rather than from this paragraph, and the two now agree.

  58  end-at-line-ending              a coordinate names column 0 of a line that exists. There is no column 0; this is how "ends at the line ending" gets spelled when the only vocabulary is a coordinate. FIFTY-FIVE are a block's end, H14's neighbour (§11.4). THE OTHER THREE ARE NEW AND ARE 0a.6's: un-gating adjust_subj_node_newlines made a code span that opens with a line ending report `1:3..3:0`, whose start is one past the end of a two-byte line and whose end is column zero — and both halves are exactly what cmark-gfm reports, which is why specs/positions/inline-sourcepos.json reads zero over them. Agreeing with an authority that is itself wrong is not a defect this stage introduced; it is the same class, made visible. No step owns it.
  22  continuation-line-content-offset  a column taken from the paragraph's CONTENT buffer and printed against a source line whose prefix was stripped. Two spaces, aaa, newline, one space, bbb gives Text 2:3..2:5 on a four-byte line. §4.2's 0a.12 calls this out as the residue it does NOT fix: Q22/Step 10.
   9  recovered-table-cell            a cell the table extension synthesized carries L:0..L:0. Requirement 10.
   9  unmatched-code-span-literal     an unmatched backtick run's literal is placed one column right: `hi`lo` gives Text 1:5..1:8 inside a seven-byte paragraph. §4.1.3 names it and assigns it to Step 8.
  --  multi-line-span AND end-column-never-set ARE BOTH GONE, and they are recorded here rather than deleted because each was cleared by a DIFFERENT defect than the one the ledger named. multi-line-span was nineteen, then seven, then one, then none: 0a.6 cleared the twelve that were inline Code and HTML; 0a.12 cleared the six that survived, and the attribution those six carried was WRONG -- they said `0a.6 - D3, un-gating adjust_subj_node_newlines`, which could never have reached them, because neither `handle_close_bracket` nor `handle_backslash` calls that helper (one was D19's link, five were D32's backslash hard break); 0a.14 cleared the last, which was D12's, by taking a merged run's end LINE and column together. end-column-never-set was six: exactly three were the strikethrough delimiter run, cleared by 0a.12's one line -- against this file's own claim that "the corpus carries the autolink spelling of it and not yet the strikethrough one", which was wrong in both halves -- and the other three were autolink's zero-length split fragments, cleared at 0a.14 by not creating them.
   6  split-off-table-lead            the paragraph a table was split out of, and its inline children, keep positions belonging to neither half. Requirement 10.

   2  content-start-past-marker-line  a footnote definition starts at the column after its marker, which does not exist when the marker ends the line: [^footnote]: is twelve bytes and the definition starts at 19:13. NOT NAMED BY ANY DEFECT IN §2; found by this oracle.

Thirty-seven of the 106 are inline, out of 2,275 inline nodes; the gate prints that split on every run.

`class` is analysis and `closedBy` is measurement. Two families carry a measured owner: the three end-at-line-ending rows 0a.6 created, and the one multi-line-span row 0a.14 owns. The consumed-definition-line family is GONE — 0a.12 cleared all three, which is the attribution proved by moving them. Every other family's owner is deliberately unassigned — the step that moves the rows proves the attribution by moving them, and this gate's CLEARED list is that proof. D35 is the newest such proof: three end-at-line-ending rows were an HTML block whose terminator sits on its own opening line, which `finalize` ended at `line_number - 1`.

A coordinate on line zero is NOT counted here; scripts/audit-scope-sanity.mjs owns the 0:0..0:0 sentinel and the line-zero-with-a-column shape, and there is no line to measure a column against. A zero COLUMN on a real line is measurable and is counted. Where a row is both — Text 1:1..1:0 is a zero column AND a reversed range — the two ratchets interlock rather than overlap: making the end a real column at or after the start clears both, while zeroing the node clears this one and GROWS the sentinel budget, which fails there.

WHAT THIS ORACLE STILL CANNOT SEE, named at 0a.6 so it is not re-derived: a scope that is a place and is still wrong. `a <b`, newline, `c> d` gives HTML scope=1:3..2:1 for a literal whose last byte is at 2:2, so the closing byte belongs to no node — and 2:1 is a perfectly good place. Containment sees a gap, not an overlap, and upstream reports the same numbers. It is pinned as a golden row in regression.txt with prose above it, and it belongs to Step 8.
